integrity: Seven standalone UTF-8 files packaged with exact per-file byte counts and SHA-256; verifier corroborates formula in finite instances only; analytical proof is primary evidence.
scientific_limitations: Unnormalized weighted Laplacian on even-order complete graphs with a single prescribed perfect matching, two homogeneous price classes and a fixed linear budget. Time, price and network-size transition proved analytically; does not cover partial matchings, general costs, normalized dynamics or limits where the premium price approaches two with size. Novelty remains qualified by possible unindexed equivalents; no independent mathematical validation.
title: Finite-horizon reactivation of costly matching edges in complete diffusion networks
